method: Remote page-reader tool; selected returned chunks inspected, not a full re-verification of all 64 products. Text observations are not checkout quotes or a physical assay.

observations.observed_text: Near the karat quality mark, look for the name or the U.S. registered trademark of the company that will stand behind the mark. The phrase solid gold means the gold item isn't hollow.
observations.finding: Consumer guidance corroborates karat plus maker/trademark checks. Plated, vermeil and filled descriptions must be distinguished. This is guidance, not verification of any individual ring.
